d:
India and China have held nearly 10 days of military-level talks to ease tensions along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Arunachal Pradesh. The discussions, which began on November 8, focused on preventing face-offs between troops and establishing new protocols. But what triggered the latest tensions in Upper Subansiri's Taksing area? Why does China claim Arunachal Pradesh, and how does the McMahon Line factor into the dispute? We explain the border tensions, recent developments and the challenges ahead as winter approaches.
Production: Akash
Video Editor: Goransh
